Game Overview

In Sea Maiden, the core idea is straightforward: plunge into Sea Maiden's mesmerizing underwater world filled with enchanting anime-inspired visuals. Navigate through mysterious marine life using intuitive controls, completing diverse missions for rewards. Discover hidden treasures and power-ups to enhance your journey as you explore uncharted ocean depths, leveling up with each new discovery.
